title: Artifact exists, but the human cannot accept it

claim.text: The agent completed the policy memo because it returned COMPLETED and produced an artifact.

scenario.requested_outcome: A policy memo accepted by a human reviewer with the required evidence map.

acceptance.initial_reason: The memo exists, but the acceptance-criteria mapping and owner sign-off are missing.

limitations: All task states, review decisions, evidence fields, minutes, and costs are invented.
The verifier checks this fixture's declared state; it does not authenticate a reviewer or inspect a real system.
The result demonstrates a failure pattern, not a customer result, certification, causal effect, or production benchmark.
The cost is a small synthetic estimate and excludes any unlisted opportunity or operational cost.
